1.d4 d5 2.c4 dxc4 3.Nf3 Nf6 4.Qa4+ c6 5..strategy: Takes the pawn back with the queen, so the material is level. The queen is active on c4 but exposed to ...b5, which the c6-pawn supports, so White has to keep an eye on its queen while Black develops with tempo.
1.d4 d5 2.c4 dxc4 3.Nf3 Nf6 4.Qa4+ c6 5..name: Queen's Gambit Accepted: Mannheim Variation

1.d4 d5 2.c4 dxc4 3.Nf3 Nf6 4.Qa4+ c6 5..strategy: Frees the f8-bishop and builds a solid centre with pawns on c6 and e6. The cost is that the c8-bishop is shut in for the time being, and the queen on c4 still has to watch for ...b5.
